body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

I have RTX Pro 6000. But sensorsim container can not working on it.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Could you check when sensorsim image support for Blackwell ?
And where can I download the latest one?
https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/questions-about-nurec-container/350490
In here, "The nurec container itself is not open source—it is a pre-packaged runtime you pull from NVIDIA’s registry (NGC), including proprietary checkpoints. Its code is closed, although you can use its models and API for your own data."
However, I can not find "nurec container" on NVIDIA’s NGC.
And the "https://hub.docker.com/r/carlasimulator/nvidia-nurec-grpc" is too old.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Could you check when sensorsim image support for Blackwell ?
And
Where can I downloads the sensorsim image ?

**Additional context**

Can I build the sensorsim render (such as libnrend_cc_100.so) ?
